column9: Spey Fumare (2016) was explicitly 'the first ever peated whisky from the Speyside distillery'; core range stays none.
Explicit 'Peated Single Malt' release, described as gentle/delicate smokiness rather than an extreme Islay-style peating - medium rather than heavy.
'Fortnight' is a heavily peated (54ppm) once-a-year release, distinct from the unpeated core Stobcross/Napier range.
Prophecy is Jura's heavily peated limited-edition line, distinct from the core (recorded light overall).
Permanent no-age-statement expression named simply 'Peat', introduced 2016; treated as heavy given the Islay peated-malt convention.
